LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASS: DETERMINERS: QUANTIFIERS:

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers:. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Which words do we use to show amount or quantity?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts
2. use quantifying determiners few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least appropriately in a variety of contexts

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use quantifying determiners few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least appropriately in a variety of contexts
   In simple words: practise until you can use quantifying determiners few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least appropriately in a variety of contexts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers:.
4. Show that you can: identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a passage related to the theme and identify quantifying determiners from the passage collaboratively,
2. List quantifying determiners that can be used with both countable and uncountable nouns,
3. Read sentences containing quantifying determiners from the internet with peers,
4. Construct sentences using quantifying determiners with nouns with peers,
5. Self-Efficacy is nurtured as the learner uses quantifying determiners in sentences correctly and learns to apply them in life.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which words do we use to show amount or quantity?
2. Why is it important to tell the quantity of something?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts
2. use quantifying determiners few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least appropriately in a variety of contexts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
